{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed = df[df["status"] == "completed"]

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed[completed["revenue"] == "999999.99"]
print(f'QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for any non-numeric revenue values
invalid_revenue = completed["revenue"].str.contains("[^0-9.,]")
print(f'Any invalid revenue strings? {invalid_revenue.any()}')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
completed["revenue_float"] = completed["revenue"].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders, excluding QA orders
mean_revenue = completed["revenue_float"].mean()

# Output
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: ${mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
